|game_text=Deploy on Senate. May raise your converted Senate to the top. Jedi here are politics +4. While your total politics here is > 5, at battlegrounds where you have an Imperial, your Force drains and battle destiny draws are +1. |errata_history=This is the original printed text (version 1 of 4). The image here is the release-sheet slip that prints it. The current text is [[Expand The Empire (V) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3): the Master List of 27 April 2013. The PC card image ([[Expand The Empire (V) (Errata 2)]], PC-E2) and the Master List both print this text again word for word.
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 5 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “Deploy on Senate. May raise your converted Senate to the top. Jedi here are politics +4. While your total politics here is > 5, at battlegrounds where you have an Imperial, your Force drains and battle destiny draws are +1. Your Maul, aliens (except Mara), [Independent Starship] starships, and senators are lost. (Immune to Alter.)”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock5">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf#page=2 Virtual Block 5 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"), page 2, slip 18. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095234/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf#page=2 Internet Archive]</ref> Document: the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB5-18-Expand_The_Empire.png]]) prints slip number “18” bottom right.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Expand The Empire (V) (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) reordered the list of lost cards: “Your Maul, aliens (except Mara), [Independent Starship] starships, and senators are lost” became “Your aliens (except Mara), senators, Maul, and [Independent Starship] starships are lost”. PC-E1 text: “Deploy on Senate. May raise your converted Senate to the top. Jedi here are politics +4. While your total politics here is > 5, at battlegrounds where you have an Imperial, your Force drains and battle destiny draws are +1. Your aliens (except Mara), senators, Maul, and [Independent Starship] starships are lost. (Immune to Alter.)”<ref name="cl-1250_14-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock5Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064732/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref> The PC website card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so its wording follows that data; it is listed as a version because the PC published it.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Expand The Empire (V) (Errata 2)]]): Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB5-D-expandtheempire-pre.gif]]), on the PC website by 25 February 2013 (server upload date)<ref name="pcimg-Virtual5-Dark">Players Committee card image, file <code>cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual5-Dark/large/expandtheempire.gif</code>; the directory listing of this folder (Virtual5-Dark) was not captured; the captured Legacy folders (Virtual2, Virtual4, Virtual5, Virtual6, Virtual7) all carry 25-Feb-2013 11:33/11:34, the date the PC rebuilt its image set (research R6, 11 November 2026: these are bulk upload dates, and an image may have been made earlier). Today's copy: https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/legacy/VirtualBlock5-Dark/large/expandtheempire.gif</ref>: “Deploy on Senate. May raise your converted Senate to the top. Jedi here are politics +4. While your total politics here is > 5, at battlegrounds where you have an Imperial, your Force drains and battle destiny draws are +1. Your Maul, aliens (except Mara), [Independent Starship] starships, and senators are lost. [Immune to Alter]” '''What changed:''' the PC card image prints the original release-sheet text of 7 December 2009 again, word for word, after the PC website card list (PC-E1) had published a different text. It is listed as its own version, placed at its upload date (Bill's rulings of 11 November 2026: a PC card image is its own version, placed at its date (here its server upload date), even when its words repeat an earlier version; whatever was published last is current). The date is only the folder's bulk upload date: the image may have been made earlier, so its place in the order is uncertain, but the versioning order follows the upload date. Document: the PC card image is a whole card (art, title bar, lore, icons, frame and the Virtual Block 5 set mark) and prints the number “18” bottom right, as the release-sheet slip does.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Expand The Empire (V) (Errata 3)]]): Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side p. 25), official text as of 27 April 2013<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=25, page 25. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=25 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploy on Senate. May raise your converted Senate to the top. Jedi here are politics +4. While your total politics here is > 5, at battlegrounds where you have an Imperial, your Force drains and battle destiny draws are +1. Your Maul, aliens (except Mara), [Independent Starship] starships, and senators are lost. [Immune to Alter]” '''What changed:''' the Master List prints the original release-sheet text of 7 December 2009 again, word for word. It is the last publication, so it is the current text; it is listed as its own version because it was published (Bill's rulings of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even one that repeats an earlier text word for word; whatever was published last is current). The image on its page is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1250-14-master.png]]). Document: the Master List slip prints no slip number.
